title: Persona Learning from Feedback for Personalized AI Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2610.38561v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalizing AI assistants requires adapting their behavior to users' preferences and task contexts. Existing work elicits assistant personas through persona prompting or finetuning on persona-conditioned generations. However, persona descriptions alone do not identify what to change or preserve in a particular response, or which behaviors suit the current request. We introduce $\textit{Persona Learning from Feedback (PLF)}$, a framework that learns reusable, preference-grounded assistant personas as independent LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone. During training, a frozen self-teacher conditions on persona specifications and response-specific feedback to provide token-level supervision on each adapter's own generated prefixes. A feedback gate focuses corrective updates on responses judged to need improvement. translated_title: 基于反馈的角色学习用于个性化AI助手
translated_abstract: 个性化AI助手需要使其行为适应用户的偏好和任务情境。现有工作通过角色提示或在角色条件化的生成数据上进行微调来引导助手人设。然而，仅凭角色描述无法确定在特定回复中应当改变或保留什么，也无法确定哪些行为适合当前的请求。我们提出了“基于反馈的角色学习”，这是一个框架，它在共享的冻结骨干模型之上，将可复用的、基于偏好的助手角色学习为独立的LoRA适配器。在训练过程中，一个冻结的自教师模型以角色规范和针对具体回复的反馈为条件，对每个适配器自身生成的前缀提供词元级别的监督。一个反馈门控将纠正性更新集中于被判定需要改进的回复上。在部署时，一个有监督的路由器利用请求或对话内容来选择单个适配器或固定的组合方式……
tldr: 提出了基于反馈的角色学习（PLF）框架，在冻结骨干模型上将个性化助手人设学习为独立的LoRA适配器，结合自教师词元级监督与反馈门控，并通过路由器在部署时选择适配器，从而实现对用户偏好的个性化适配。
en_tdlr: Proposes Persona Learning from Feedback (PLF), a framework that learns reusable, preference-grounded assistant personas as independent LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone, using a frozen self-teacher for token-level supervision and a feedback gate to focus corrective updates, with a supervised router selecting adapters at deployment.
